title: Chill & Play!
description: Chill & Play is a new minecraft modpack, focusing around new and vanilla + content, improvements, stunning world gen, and amazing visuals with good performance, and more!
body:
**Chill & Play**

A carefully curated vanilla+ Fabric modpack (1.21.1) focused on relaxing gameplay, immersive visuals, and meaningful content expansion—without overwhelming the core Minecraft feel.

**What is this modpack?**

Chill & Play enhances Minecraft by blending performance, atmosphere, and exploration into one smooth experience. It keeps the game recognizable while upgrading almost every aspect—from world generation to sound design.

Whether you're building, exploring, or just vibing, this pack is made to feel cozy, alive, and modern.


**Visual Overhaul**

Shader support via Iris + Sodium
Realistic lighting, shadows, and sky atmosphere
Enhanced models, textures, and animations
Falling leaves, better particles, and environmental details

**Immersion & Audio**

Dynamic ambient sounds
Improved sound physics
More realistic movement and environment feedback


**Performance & Optimization**

Powered by Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, and more
Smooth gameplay even with heavy visuals
Optimized for stability and fast loading


**Quality of Life**

Better UI, tooltips, and inventory management
Waystones for fast travel
Mouse tweaks, zoom, and usability improvements
Enhanced third-person camera


**Vanilla+ Content Expansion**

New blocks and decorative options
Farming and food improvements
Backpacks and storage upgrades
Subtle additions that fit naturally into Minecraft


**Technical Info**

Minecraft Version: 1.21.1
Mod Loader: Fabric
Focus: Vanilla+, Performance, Visuals, Exploration


**⚠️ Notes**
Shaders are optional but highly recommended
Works best with a mid-range PC or better
Some world generation mods require a new world

**Bug Reports**

If you encounter issues, report them here:
https://github.com/Jeagrr/Chill-Play/issues
